parameters.name: Land (base)
parameters.description: The Land color is primarily used to style the map background and other bare-land features. It also influences admin borders/labels and will be used as a “base” to derive any other undefined map color.
parameters.summary: Map background and other bare-land features, influences admin borders/labels. Also used to derive all map colors if undefined.

parameters.name: Water
parameters.description: The Water color is primarily used to style waterbodies, waterways and other water features. It also influences other water-related map objects such as glaciers, water labels and ferry lines.
parameters.summary: Waterbodies, waterways and other water features. Also influences glaciers, water labels and ferry lines.

parameters.name: Vegetation
parameters.description: The Vegetation color is primarily used to style forests and other classes of vegetated land cover such as grass and shrubland. It also influences styling of earth cover vegetation at smaller scales.
parameters.summary: Forests and other land cover such as grass and shrubland. Also influences earth cover vegetation at smaller scales.

parameters.name: Park & Recreation
parameters.description: The Park & Recreation color is primarily used to style city parks and sport/recreation grounds. It also influences the visualization of National Parks and other protected areas at smaller scales.
parameters.summary: City parks and sport/recreation grounds. Also influences National Parks and other protected areas at smaller scales.

parameters.name: Artificial
parameters.description: The Artificial color is primarily used to style built-up-areas and man-made features such as landuse grounds and buildings. It also influences styling of railways and other artificial objects.
parameters.summary: Built-up-areas and man-made features such as landuse grounds and buildings Also influences railways.

parameters.name: Major Road
parameters.description: The Major Road color is primarily used to style motorways and other major classes such as trunks and primary roads. It also influences outline and tunnel colors for the same road classes.
parameters.summary: Most important road classes, from motorways & trunks to primary roads. Also influences outline and tunnel colors.

parameters.name: Road
parameters.description: The Road color is primarily used to style secondary/tertiary roads and less important road classes such as streets and service roads. It also influences tunnel colors for the same road classes.
parameters.summary: Less important road classes, from secondary/tertiary to streets and service roads. Also influences tunnel colors.

parameters.name: Road Outline
parameters.description: The Road Outline color is primarily used to style road outlines for secondary/tertiary roads and minor classes. It also influences road labels and all other road outline colors including tunnels.
parameters.summary: Road outlines for secondary/tertiary roads and minor classes. Also influences road labels and all other outline colors.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: The Label color is primarily used to style labels for capitals and all other populated places/admin areas. It also influences border styling and all other label colors including roads and POIs.
parameters.summary: Labels for capitals and other populated places/admin areas. Also influences border styling and all other label colors.

parameters.name: Label Outline
parameters.description: The Label Outline color is primarily used to style outlines for populated places and admin area labels. It also influences styling of border outlines and all other label halos including roads and POIs.
parameters.summary: Outlines for populated places and admin area labels. Also influences border outlines and all other label halos.

parameters.name: Global symbol size
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the size of all symbols (text and icon) in the map, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other size factors at module level.

parameters.name: Enable Anti-occlusion
parameters.summary: Enable layers to display certain map features (e.g. roads, traffic incidents tubes) even when occluded by 3d objects. Please note such layers are not displayed correctly in Map Maker.

parameters.name: Enable 3d Landmarks
parameters.summary: Enable layers to display 3D Landmarks models and filter out standard building extrusions accordingly. Please note landmarks won't be visible in Map Maker.

parameters.name: Enable Lane Level Visualization (on style reload)
parameters.summary: Enable detailed lane-level visualization layers for roads, including tarmac area and lane separator markings. Please note coverage of these layers is limited to specific areas and road classes.

parameters.name: Enable bloom
parameters.summary: Sets if the bloom pass is enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: Bloom Threshold
parameters.summary: The bloom threshold value is the level at which the brightest part of the screen starts to produce a glowing effect. A higher threshold value will produce less bloom.

parameters.name: Bloom Intensity
parameters.summary: The bloom intensity value indicates the strength and brightness of the bloom effect. A higher value produces a much more pronounced bloom effect.

parameters.name: Bloom Scatter
parameters.summary: The bloom scatter value indicates the distance the bloom effect scatters across the screen. A higher value makes the bloom fade out further from the initial source.

parameters.name: Bloom Tint
parameters.summary: The bloom tint value acts as a global color which is applied to the final bloom texture. By setting this value all the bloom effects which are drawn to the screen get a unified global color tint applied to them.

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level

parameters.name: Tarmac outline width
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the width of all tarmac outlines, compared to the default values. Note that it will not be combined with other width factors.

parameters.name: Tarmac outline change rate
parameters.summary: A factor to control the rate of change for tarmac outline widths between zoom levels. 1 is linear, 2 is exponential (delayed increase).

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.summary: The opacity value for the anti-occlusion road lines, which will be visible only when obstructed by 3d objects.

parameters.name: Brightness factor
parameters.summary: The additional brightness factor applied to the anti-occlusion road lines. Negative values will darken the original colors, positive lighten them.

parameters.name: Path

parameters.name: Track
parameters.summary: Base color for tracks. By default it is derived from the Road foundation color and influenced by Road Outline.

parameters.name: Paths label

parameters.name: Paths label outline
parameters.summary: Base color for track and path name label outlines. By default it is derived from the Label Outline foundation color with additional transparency.

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level
parameters.summary: The minimum zoom level at which any feature in this module will be visualized. Note that certain features can still appear later.

parameters.name: Zoom level shift
parameters.summary: A shift in appearance of road features of one or more zoom levels earlier or later, compared to default values. This can help reduce or increase density of features at certain scales.

parameters.name: Line width
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the width of all lines in this module, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other width factors.

parameters.name: Text size
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the size of all text labels in this module, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other size factors.

parameters.name: Track width
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the width of all track lines, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other width factors.

parameters.name: Path width
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the width of all path lines, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other width factors.

parameters.name: Pattern dash width
parameters.summary: The dash size for the path lines pattern. Use minimum to draw a dotted line

parameters.name: Pattern gap width
parameters.summary: The gap size for the path lines pattern. Use minimum to draw a solid line.

parameters.name: Tunnel pattern dash width
parameters.summary: The dash size for the tunnel path lines pattern. Use minimum to draw a dotted line

parameters.name: Tunnel pattern gap width

parameters.name: Ferries

parameters.name: Railways

parameters.name: Aeroways

parameters.name: Platforms

parameters.name: Aerialways

parameters.name: Text size

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level

parameters.name: Building extrusion
parameters.summary: Base color for building extrusions. By default it is derived from the Artificial foundation color.

parameters.name: Building footprint
parameters.summary: Base color for building footprints. By default it is derived from the Artificial foundation color.

parameters.name: Building outline
parameters.summary: Base color for building outlines. By default it is derived from the Building footprint color.

parameters.name: Building shadow
parameters.summary: Base color for building shadows. By default it is derived from the Building footprint color.

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level
parameters.summary: The minimum zoom level at which any feature in this module will be visualized. Note that certain features can still appear later.

parameters.name: Extrusion opacity
parameters.summary: The transparency value of extruded buildings. 1 is fully opaque, 0.5 is half transparent.

parameters.name: Underground footprints
parameters.summary: Visualize underground buildings with half-transparent footprint

parameters.name: Building faux shadow
parameters.summary: Visualize faux 2d shadow along building footprints

parameters.name: Building outline
parameters.summary: Visualize perimeter outline along building footprints

parameters.name: Multiply base texture
parameters.summary: The value indicates if the incoming albedo texture should be multiplied with itself. The result of the multiplication would be a higher contrasting albedo image.

parameters.name: Gradient bottom color
parameters.summary: If use gradient is set to true this color indicates the bottom color of the gradient.

parameters.name: Gradient top color
parameters.summary: If use gradient is set to true this color indicates the top color of the gradient.

parameters.name: Bottom lighting color
parameters.summary: If use bottom lighting is set to true this parameter indicates the color of the added lighting.

parameters.name: Bottom lighting falloff
parameters.summary: The property indicates the falloff of the bottom lighting if enabled. 0 gives the bottom lighting no falloff resulting in the lighting stretching all the way to the top of the landmark. A higher value will result in a smaller gradient towards the bottom of the landmark.

parameters.name: Metallic
parameters.summary: The metallic value for the material. The value ranges from 0 to 1. Where 0 is non-metallic and 1 is completely metallic.

parameters.name: Smoothness
parameters.summary: The smoothness value for the material. The value ranges from 0 to 1. Where 0 indicates a rough surface with almost no reflection and 1 a smooth surface with a sharp reflection.

parameters.name: Roof metallic
parameters.summary: The metallic value for the the roof of the buildings. The value ranges from 0 to 1. Where 0 is non-metallic and 1 is completely metallic.

parameters.name: Roof smoothness
parameters.summary: The smoothness value for the roof of the buildings. The value ranges from 0 to 1. Where 0 indicates a rough surface with almost no reflection and 1 a smooth surface with a sharp reflection.

parameters.name: Use specular highlights
parameters.summary: The value indicates if specular highlights are active.

parameters.name: Gradient bottom color
parameters.summary: If use gradient is set to true this color indicates the bottom color of the gradient.

parameters.name: Gradient top color
parameters.summary: If use gradient is set to true this color indicates the top color of the gradient.

parameters.name: Water label

parameters.name: Water label outline
parameters.summary: Base color for water label outlines. By default it is derived from the Water foundation color and not influenced by Label outline color

parameters.name: Waterbody
parameters.summary: Base color for waterbodies, including oceans and seas. By default it matches the Water foundation color.

parameters.name: Waterway
parameters.summary: Base color for waterways, including artificial canals. By default it matches the Water foundation color.

parameters.name: Ice
parameters.summary: Base color for glaciers and permanent snow-covered areas. By default it is derived from the Water foundation color.

parameters.name: Text size
parameters.summary: A multiplication factor for the text size of all water labels, compared to the default values. Note that it can be combined with other size factors.

parameters.name: Waterway minimum zoom level
parameters.summary: The minimum zoom level at which any waterway label be visualized. Note that certain features can still appear later.

parameters.name: Fade water at high zoom
parameters.summary: When enabled, water bodies gradually fade out at high zoom levels. Primarily designed for satellite styles to reveal detail beneath the water layer.

parameters.name: Start zoom level
parameters.summary: Zoom level at which the water fade-out transition begins.

parameters.name: End zoom level
parameters.summary: Zoom level at which the water fade-out reaches its minimum opacity.

parameters.name: Opacity at end zoom
parameters.summary: Opacity of water bodies at and above the end zoom level. Set to 0 to make water fully transparent at close zoom.

parameters.name: Intermittent waterbodies
parameters.summary: Visualize intermittent or seasonal waterbodies with semi-transparent area

parameters.name: Intermittent minimum zoom level
parameters.summary: The minimum zoom level at which any intermittent waterbody be visualized. Note that certain features can still appear later.

parameters.name: Waterbody faux shadow
parameters.summary: Visualize faux 2d shadow along waterbodies to simulate depth.

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level
parameters.summary: The minimum zoom level at which any waterway will be visualized. Note that certain features can still appear later.

parameters.name: UV Scale
parameters.summary: The uv scale value for the material. A higher value will result in more tiling of the textures assigned to the layer material.

parameters.name: Normal strength
parameters.summary: The normal strength value for the material. The value controls the intensity of the normal map effect, a higher value will make the normal map effect more pronounced.

parameters.name: Hillshade
parameters.summary: Base color for shaded terrain. By default it matches the Land foundation color.

parameters.name: Hillshade shadow
parameters.summary: Base color for hillshade shadow areas. By default it is derived from Hillshade color. Use alpha value to increase or decrease opacity.

parameters.name: Hillshade highlight
parameters.summary: Base color for hillshade highlight areas. By default it is derived from Hillshade color. Use alpha value to increase or decrease opacity.

parameters.name: Hillshade accent
parameters.summary: Base color for hillshade accent areas. By default it is derived from Hillshade color. Use alpha value to increase or decrease opacity.

parameters.name: Maximum zoom level
parameters.summary: The maximum zoom level at which the hillshade will be visualized. Note that the hillshade effect will be automatically faded up to this ZL.

parameters.name: Hillshade exaggeration
parameters.summary: Vertical exaggeration factor for the hillshade.

parameters.name: Maximum zoom level
parameters.summary: The maximum zoom level at which satellite imagery will be visualized.

parameters.name: Opacity
parameters.summary: The opacity of the satellite imagery layer. Note that this might not be supported in certain applications.

parameters.name: Built-up area
parameters.summary: Base color for built-up areas. By default it matches the Artificial foundation color.

parameters.name: Landuse ground
parameters.summary: Base color for all landuse grounds, except protected areas and outdoor/sport ground. By default it is derived from the Artificial foundation color.

parameters.name: Protected area
parameters.summary: Base color for all protected areas, including national parks and natural reserves. By default it is derived from the Park & Recreation foundation color.

parameters.name: Park ground
parameters.summary: Base color for all city parks and outdoor related facilities. By default it matches the Park & Recreation foundation color.

parameters.name: Sport ground

parameters.name: Grassland
parameters.summary: Base color for gardens and grassland areas. By default it is derived by the Vegetation foundation color.

parameters.name: Cropland
parameters.summary: Base color for agricultural and cropland areas. By default it is derived by the Vegetation foundation color.

parameters.name: Shrubland
parameters.summary: Base color for heath and shrubland areas. By default it is derived by the Vegetation foundation color.

parameters.name: Sand
parameters.summary: Base color for beaches and sandy areas. By default it is derived by the Land foundation color.

parameters.name: Bareland
parameters.summary: Base color for rocky and bareland areas. By default it is derived by the Land foundation color.

parameters.name: Background
parameters.summary: Base color for the background of the map. By default it matches the Land foundation color.

parameters.name: Minimum zoom level

parameters.name: Symbol size
